intended_use.description: Repo-relative path to the intended-use / GxP impact statement.

frameworks.description: Display metadata for framework families, keyed by family slug. Single source for the generated compliance-model table (#2); validate.ts enforces that every family a control uses has an entry here, and that no entry is an orphan.

label.description: Human-readable framework name shown in the generated table, e.g. "21 CFR Part 11".

sort.description: Row-grouping order in the generated table (ascending).

data_classes.description: Regulated-data categories this family brings into scope for op-data-scan (#10). A consuming profile's declared families union their data_classes to determine what the scan looks for. Open vocabulary; packs extend it (e.g. ca-personal-information, eu-personal-data).

families.description: Framework families a consuming repo may declare in its profile. A control whose family is absent from a repo's profile is inert for that repo.

id.description: Stable control identifier, e.g. CTL-HIPAA-001. Never reused.

family.description: Must be one of profiles.families (enforced semantically by validate.ts).

jurisdiction.description: Legal regime, open vocabulary: us, us-ca, eu, global, ... New jurisdictions need no schema change.

applicability.description: Product/data contexts that trigger the control, open vocabulary: us-phi, us-regulated-records, eu-personal-data, eu-samd, all, ...

evidence.description: Evidence artifact paths (glob-ish) produced in consuming repos.

status.description: pin-pending = at least one pinnable citation has no pin yet (enforced semantically by validate.ts).

citationFedreg.description: A Federal Register docket, polled via the free federalregister.gov API (no key, CI-reachable). Used as the drift signal for guidance documents whose own host blocks datacenter IPs (e.g. FDA PDFs 404 from GitHub runners). A new document on the docket = a revision to watch.

docket.description: Federal Register docket id, e.g. FDA-2022-D-0795.

latest_document_number.description: Newest document number on the docket at pin time, e.g. 2025-18468.

citationEcfr.description: US federal regulation via the eCFR Versioner API (public domain; pinnable and drift-watchable).

amendment_date.description: Latest amendment date of the pinned part per the Versioner API.

checked.description: Date the pin was last verified against the API.

citationEurlex.description: EU law via EUR-Lex CELEX/ELI (freely reusable; pinnable and drift-watchable). Reserved for the framework packs (#7, #9) — schema-ready now so packs need no schema change.

citationDocument.description: Public guidance document (FDA guidance, MDCG, EudraLex annex, state statute page) pinned by URL + sha256.

normalization.description: raw = checksum the bytes (PDFs). text = strip markup and collapse whitespace before checksumming (HTML statute pages), so template changes don't fire false drift alarms.

auto_poll.description: false = the upstream drift watch (#4) skips re-fetching this source because its host blocks datacenter IPs (e.g. FDA PDFs 404 from GitHub runners). The sha256 pin still records the last manually-verified state; pair with a fedreg citation for the automated signal. Listed as 'manual re-verification' in the watcher summary.

citationClause.description: Copyrighted framework cited by clause identifier ONLY. No text body is representable — additionalProperties:false makes vendoring paywalled text a schema violation, not a policy violation.

edition_note.description: Human note about which edition; new-edition checks are manual (no automated polling of paywalled sources).

type.description: skill → skills/<ref>/SKILL.md must exist. hook → hooks/<ref>.md must exist. architecture → posture documented in docs/compliance-model.md (no file check).
